chunks: My father, may Allah have mercy on him, said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated to us, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah, who raised it to Abu Abdillah Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, peace be upon them both, who said:

The Prophet (peace be upon him and his Family) performed blood-letting (hijamah) in his head, between his shoulders, and on the back of his neck three times. He named one 'The Beneficial', the other 'The Refuging', and the third 'The Saving'.
ai.seo_question: What are the three specific locations and names associated with the Prophet's blood-letting practice?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Ma'ani al-Akhbar*, this hadith traces the Prophet’s practice of hijamah through the Imams, emphasizing the spiritual nomenclature of the three sessions as 'The Beneficial, The Refuging, and The Saving. This tradition underscores the Shia view of hijamah not merely as physical therapy but as a Sunnah imbued with divine efficacy and protection, often linked to the purification of the body and soul.
